candidates.explanation: Guard guards disableModule(address,address) but decodes the argument at offset 0x24 (the wrong argument) instead of 0x44 (the protected `module`). The whitelist/allow check therefore validates the wrong address, so a renter can remove a required module (reclaim/stop/settlement) by routing the disable through an allowed predecessor (reNFT H-04 class).
candidates.false_positive_controls: two-signal (Safe-guard selector-filter context + >=1 Safe self-mgmt selector covered) AND a concrete defect (decode-offset mismatch OR missing high-impact selector); admin-only downgraded; non-guard suppressed
